shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!build'"' | sed -n '1,200p' && git status --short && git branch --show-current"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/ProductList.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/Recommendations.tsx && git diff -- package.json && git diff --stat && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "test -d node_modules && echo node_modules-present || echo node_modules-missing
node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" 2>/dev/null || true
rg -n \"cacheComponents|experimental_ppr|ppr:\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,240p'
rg -n '\"next\"|node_modules/next|version' package-lock.json | sed -n '1,80p'
sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- next.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json && git diff --check && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts && find .next -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed -n '1,40p' && find .next -maxdepth 2 -type d | sed -n '1,40p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'find .next -depth -delete
git status --short
git diff --check
git diff -- next.config.ts
git diff -- tsconfig.json'
